scope: All target-band components and the largest free component at each case last accepted and saved maximum-target state; every original bulk/interface interaction is included.
interpretation: Zero live cross-boundary edges certifies discrete material-graph separation. Pre-existing cut edges are counted separately. This does not reconstruct or certify a continuous three-dimensional crack surface.
